purpose: Generate explainable code-change identity-relation candidates from TDX and BaoStock source behavior; never confirm identity.
inputs: hash-bound TDX .day file metadata and overlap summaries
effective date and exchange-qualified source keys

research_thresholds.calibration_status: EXPLORATORY_ONLY; validation is bounded to two positive and two merger-successor controls; no threshold is accepted for production.

feature_policy.suspended_row_normalization: Only when both tradestatus=0; volume or amount blank and numeric zero are treated as equivalent representation for candidate scoring while strict raw values remain captured.
feature_policy.amount_tolerance: NONE; all non-equal amount values remain explicit mismatches.

all_required: new TDX code contains pre-effective history
both BaoStock long-history queries succeed and provider row codes match their query codes
BaoStock new-code query contains at least the configured minimum count of pre-effective dates on which both queried aliases are actual trades and at least the configured exact business-field ratio
either old/new TDX files provide a long semantic overlap signal, or the old TDX file is absent while the new TDX file starts at the shared IPO anchor and BaoStock lifecycle metadata is continuous
no date shows materially different actual-trade bars under both aliases
candidate_rule.interpretation: Candidate-only source behavior; official or independently accepted versioned evidence is still required to resolve SAME_ENTITY.

prohibited: same-entity confirmation from source fingerprint alone

fail_closed.unresolved_or_incomplete: Do not alter identity; preserve as candidate evidence or unresolved diagnostic.
